name: High-side switch
description: Load switched to V+ (high side). Requires P-channel FET or N-channel with bootstrapped gate drive.
topology: P-MOSFET or N-MOSFET + gate driver + load
expected_signal_behavior: When on: load sees V+; FET source at V+, drain at load. Gate drive must be V+ - VGS for P-FET or V+ + VGS for N-FET (bootstrapped).
recommended_next_tests: check gate voltage relative to SOURCE (not ground)
